title: 第一卷 第23章 铁头功立功劳
novel_title: 津门武圣，从苦力开始每日结算
content_zh:
津门三号码头。

    正午的日头毒辣，把青石板晒得冒油。

    平日里这个时候，码头上全是号子声和搬运声，今儿个却静得吓人。

    几百号苦力缩在仓库阴影里，大气不敢喘。

    码头空地上，两拨人马对峙。

    左边是赵海柱带来的海河帮，百十号汉子，清一色的短打黑褂，手里提着哨棒眼神凶悍。

    赵海柱大马金刀地坐在太师椅上，手里盘着两颗铁核桃，咯吱咯吱响。

    右边是漕运商会的人。

    几十号打手，黑压压一片。

    最前头站着个胖子。

    白净脸，没胡子，一身绸缎长衫，肚子挺得像个怀胎十月的孕妇。

    魏兴。

    漕运商会的“魏小财神”。

    管着津门漕运大半的流水，每天手里过的银子能把人埋了。

    “赵海柱。”

    魏兴笑眯眯地开口，声音尖细像个太监，“你这手伸得太长了吧？津门码头的水深，小心淹死。”

    赵海柱吐了口浓痰，正好吐在魏兴脚边。

    “魏太监，少跟老子扯淡。”

    “你那点腌臜事，老子懒得管。”

    “今儿个是比武招管事，规矩大家都懂。”

    “输了别哭鼻子找你洋爹去。”

    魏兴脸色一僵。

    他那双总是眯着的笑眼猛地睁开，闪过一丝怨毒。

    早年间帮派火拼，他被人废了下三路，这辈子别想有后。

    这是他的死穴。

    赵海柱这张臭嘴，专挑痛处戳。

    “好，好得很。”

    魏兴怒极反笑，脸上的肉抖了抖，“赵海柱，希望你的嘴能跟你的拳头一样硬。”

    他侧过身，拍了拍手。

    “朱成，出来。”

    人群分开。

    走出一个瘦高个。

    这人脸色蜡黄，眼窝深陷，最显眼的是那一双手。

    漆黑如墨，像是刚从墨汁里捞出来的，还在往下滴着黑水。

    散发着一股腥臭味。

    “黑拳朱成。”

    张宏站在赵海柱身后，低声说道，“练的是黑毒拳，外门邪路。”

    “那双手泡过毒砂，拳头上带毒。”

    “挨着死，擦着伤。”

    赵海柱皱了皱眉，“有点恶心。”

    魏兴看着朱成，眼中闪过一丝狠厉。

    “朱成，给我打。”

    “不用留手，打死打残算我的。”

    “赢了，这码头管事是你，我再赏你五百大洋！”

    朱成那双浑浊的眼睛瞬间亮了。

    五百大洋！

    够他在租界买个院子，娶两房姨太太了。

    “多谢魏爷！”

    朱成声音沙哑，像是两块砂纸在摩擦。

    他活动了一下那双黑手，指节发出令人牙酸的“咔吧”声。

    陆川转头，看向身边的王大刚。

    王大刚今天穿了件新褂子，虽然是粗布，但洗得发白。

    他紧张得手心冒汗，腿肚子都在转筋。

    “怕吗？”

    陆川眼神淡然地问道。

    “怕。”

    王大刚老实点头，“那手看着真瘆人。”

    “怕就对了。”

    陆川拍了拍他的肩膀，“记住我昨天说的。”

    “别跟他拼拳，别跟他缠斗。”

    “你的头，比他的拳头硬。”

    “撞他。”

    王大刚咽了口唾沫，摸了摸自己的脑门。

    那是他唯一的武器。

    “去吧。”

    陆川推了他一把。

    王大刚深吸一口气，迈着沉重的步子，走进了场中。

    朱成看着走过来的王大刚，嘴角咧开一个嘲讽的弧度。

    “哪来的土包子？”

    “黑了吧唧的，也敢跟爷爷练过？”

    朱成抬起黑手，晃了晃，“闻闻这味儿，这可是断肠草配着砒霜泡的，沾点皮你就得烂肉。”

    王大刚没说话。

    他不懂什么叫垃圾话。

    他只知道，打赢了，就能给后巷那群小崽子买白面馒头。

    打输了，就得死！

    “开始！”

    赵海柱一声令下。

    朱成动了。

    身形如鬼魅，脚下踩着诡异的步伐，瞬间欺身而上。

    那双黑手带着腥风，直抓王大刚的面门。

    狠辣，刁钻。

    这一爪要是抓实了，王大刚的脸皮得被撕下来。

    围观的苦力们发出一阵惊呼。

    王大刚吓了一跳，本能地想躲。

    但他想起了陆川的话。

    别躲！

    躲了，就是死！

    他猛地一咬牙，不闪不避，反而往前踏了一步。

    脑袋一低。
content_en:
Jinmen Pier 3.

    The sun was so fierce at noon that the bluestone slabs became oily.

    Normally at this time, the pier would be filled with the sounds of shouting and moving, but today it was eerily quiet.

    Hundreds of coolies huddled in the shadows of the warehouse, not daring to breathe.

    In the open space of the pier, two groups of people faced each other.

    On the left is the Haihe Gang brought by Zhao Haizhu, a man named No. 100, all wearing short black coats, holding a whistle stick in his hand and looking fiercely.

    Zhao Haizhu sat on the Grand Master's chair with his majestic posture, holding two iron walnuts in his hand, making a crunching sound.

    On the right are people from the Water Transport Chamber of Commerce.

    There were dozens of thugs, and it was a dark place.

    There was a fat man standing at the front.

    He has a fair face and no beard. He is wearing a long satin gown and his belly is as bulging as a pregnant woman who is ten months pregnant.

    Wei Xing.

    The "Wei Little God of Wealth" of the Water Transport Chamber of Commerce.

    He was in charge of most of the water transportation in Jinmen, and the money he passed through his hands every day could bury a person's life.

    "Zhao Haizhu."

    Wei Xing spoke with a smile, his voice as shrill as a eunuch's, "Did you stretch your hand too far? The water at Jinmen Pier is deep, be careful of drowning."

    Zhao Haizhu spat out thick phlegm, which happened to be at Wei Xing's feet.

    "Eunuch Wei, please stop talking nonsense to me."

    "I don't care about your dirty laundry."

    "Today is a competition to recruit stewards. Everyone knows the rules."

    "If you lose, don't cry and go find your foreign father."

    Wei Xing's face froze.

    His smiling eyes, which were always squinted, opened suddenly, flashing with a trace of resentment.

    During the gang fights in his early years, he was eliminated from the lower ranks and had no hope of having a future in this life.

    This is his Achilles heel.

    Zhao Haizhu's foul mouth only picks and pokes at the sore spots.

    "Okay, very good."

    Wei Xing laughed angrily, and the flesh on his face trembled, "Zhao Haizhu, I hope your mouth can be as hard as your fist."

    He turned sideways and clapped his hands.

    "Zhu Cheng, come out."

    The crowd parted.

    A tall and thin man walked out.

    This man's face was sallow, his eye sockets were sunken, and the most conspicuous thing was his hands.

    It was as black as ink, as if it had just been fished out of ink, and black water was still dripping down.

    It exudes a fishy smell.

    "Black Fist Zhu Cheng."

    Zhang Hong stood behind Zhao Haizhu and whispered, "I practice black poison boxing, the outer sect is evil."

    "Those hands were soaked in poisonous sand, and the fists were poisonous."

    "To die next to one's wounds."

    Zhao Haizhu frowned, "It's a bit disgusting."

    Wei Xing looked at Zhu Cheng with a fierce look in his eyes.

    "Zhu Cheng, hit me."

    "Don't hold back. Beat me to death or cripple you."

    "If you win, you are the steward of this dock. I will reward you another five hundred yuan!"

    Zhu Cheng's cloudy eyes lit up instantly.

    Five hundred oceans!

    It was enough for him to buy a yard in the concession and marry a concubine with two bedrooms.

    "Thank you, Mr. Wei!"

    Zhu Cheng's voice was hoarse, like two pieces of sandpaper rubbing together.

    He moved his black hands, and his knuckles made a tooth-piercing "click" sound.

    Lu Chuan turned his head and looked at Wang Dagang beside him.

    Wang Dagang wore a new coat today. Although it was made of coarse cloth, it was washed white.

    He was so nervous that his palms were sweating and his calves were cramping.

    "Are you afraid?"

    Lu Chuan asked with indifferent eyes.

    "Afraid."

    Wang Dagang nodded honestly, "That hand looks really scary."

    "It's okay to be afraid."

    Lu Chuan patted his shoulder and said, "Remember what I said yesterday."

    "Don't box with him, don't fight with him."

    "Your head is harder than his fist."

    "Bump him."

    Wang Dagang swallowed and touched his forehead.

    That's his only weapon.

    "Go ahead."

    Lu Chuan pushed him.

    Wang Dagang took a deep breath and walked into the field with heavy steps.

    Zhu Cheng looked at Wang Dagang who was walking over and grinned with a mocking smile.

    "Where did that bumpkin come from?"

    "How dare you practice with grandpa even though you're so bad?"

    Zhu Cheng raised his black hand and shook it, "Smell this, this is heartbroken grass mixed with arsenic. If you touch the skin, your flesh will rot."

    Wang Dagang said nothing.

    He doesn't know what trash talk is.

    All he knew was that if he won, he could buy white-flour buns for those brats in the back alley.

    If you lose, you will die!

    "Start!"

    Zhao Haizhu gave the order.

    Zhu Cheng moved.

    The figure is like a ghost, with strange steps under his feet, and he is approaching in an instant.

    Those black hands, carrying a fishy wind, grabbed Wang Dagang's face.

    Cruel and tricky.

    If this claw were to grasp firmly, Wang Dagang's face would be torn off.

    The coolies who were watching screamed in surprise.

    Wang Dagang was startled and instinctively wanted to hide.

    But he remembered Lu Chuan's words.

    Don't hide!

    If you hide, you will die!

    He gritted his teeth suddenly and took a step forward instead of dodging.

    His head dropped.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 23 Tietou makes great contributions
